updates.note: Management reaffirmed that the working capital cycle is expected to normalize to the long-term steady range of 50 to 55 days in the coming quarters.
updates.quote: We expect this to normalize to our long-term steady range of 50 to 55 days in the coming quarters.

updates.note: Management reaffirmed the Project Spring target for FMEG EBITDA margins to be in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30.
updates.quote: remain on track to achieve our Project Spring targets of 1.5x - 2x industry growth and EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30

new_promises.statement: Project Spring annual capex guidance is 12 billion to 16 billion rupees through FY30.
new_promises.quote: in-line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30.
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

new_promises.statement: BharatNet orders expected to generate 4.5 billion rupees over the next 3 years for execution.
new_promises.quote: commenced execution of our existing orders under BharatNet scheme, which is expected to generate ₹ 4.5 billion over the next 3 years for project execution
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

new_promises.statement: BharatNet project O&M expected to generate 3.5 billion rupees over 10 years.
new_promises.quote: and an additional ₹ 3.5 billion for 10 years for project O&M.
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
